data.claim: PCLOB describes PRISM collection as selector-based acquisition in which a United States electronic communications service provider is compelled to provide communications to or from the selector.
PCLOB reports that NSA receives all PRISM collection and that CIA and FBI each receive a select portion; raw upstream collection is treated differently.
Leaked NSA PRISM presentation material published by the Guardian named Google among service providers associated with PRISM.
Google said it had not joined a program giving government direct server access or a back door and said it provided data only in accordance with law.
This pass found no direct public evidence that Pokémon GO or Niantic data was collected through PRISM.
The documented IQT investment was in Keyhole; it does not establish an IQT or CIA investment in Pokémon GO.
Shield AI is included as an adjacent autonomous-aircraft organization. This pass did not establish a direct IQT investment relation.
The WEF recursion stop condition was met through a direct 2026 Google partner roster edge; additional weaker WEF profile and editorial edges were preserved separately.

data.research_question: What public institutional and personnel records establish the CIA-In-Q-Tel root?
data.method: Use CIA and IQT official pages; separate establishment, partnership, portfolio status and operational use.
classification_rules: IQT portfolio status does not prove CIA deployment.
Only public professional people are included.

data.research_question: What sourced chain connects IQT and Keyhole to Google, Niantic and Pokémon GO?
data.method: Trace investment, acquisition, employment, internal-venture, financing, product-launch and later restructuring events.
classification_rules: The Keyhole investment is not a Pokémon GO investment.
Corporate lineage is not proof of continuing control.
Product data access requires direct evidence.

data.research_question: How does the public Section 702/PRISM record connect Google, NSA, FBI and CIA?
data.method: Use PCLOB for program mechanics and agency roles; preserve leaked-provider naming and Google's response as separate evidence classes.
classification_rules: PRISM is not labeled a CIA-run program.
Compelled provider production is distinct from direct server access.
No Niantic or Pokémon GO collection claim is made without direct evidence.

data.research_question: Which drone and autonomous-systems organizations and public people have direct sourced edges to IQT or Google lineage?
data.method: Expand from IQT portfolio records and Google X/Wing lineage into Skydio, Anduril, Advanced Navigation, Wing and adjacent Shield AI.
classification_rules: Investment, prototype, contract and deployment are separate.
Shield AI remains adjacent unless a direct IQT edge is found.
Founders and current executives are role-timestamped leads, not proof of coordination.

data.research_question: Can the recursive graph reach a direct, sourced World Economic Forum edge?
data.method: Test formal partner and Technology Pioneer records before preserving weaker profile or editorial mentions.
classification_rules: Editorial coverage is not organizational control or partnership.
